Feature ordinalFeatureBio MAF v4 blockRecommended statusFeature count originWhat this feature measuresWhy this feature is in v4Plain-English interpretationSource / groundingDownloaded/local provenanceLikely reviewer criticismResponse / rationaleSignature separation noteStrict Bio MAF v4 coreCore feature totalFull feature total including optional controlsFeature summary source
1vep_impact_count__highv3_core_compact_biologyCore Bio MAF v4 featureInherited from Bio MAF v3 core: 100 VEP annotation features + 5 VAF summaries + 12 OncoKB role aggregates + 4 residual non-OncoKB aggregates = 121 features.Count = log1p(number of events in category); fraction = category count divided by total annotated events.Retained from Bio v3 because it captures broad mutation biology with standard annotation fields and no endpoint-specific selection.Count of tumor mutations with impact = high. In plain terms: VEP severity label for how strongly the variant is expected to affect a transcript or protein. This feature measures how often the tumor has that category.Ensembl VEP annotation fieldsinput MAF VEP annotation fields; Ensembl VEP documentationAnnotation categories can overlap conceptually, and prediction fields such as SIFT/PolyPhen are imperfect.These are standard VEP fields, not custom biological groupings. Counts and fractions let the model distinguish absolute burden from composition.No COSMIC SBS/DBS/ID signature exposure is included; signatures remain a separate model matrix.Yes943948results\tables\proposed_clinical_bio_v4_feature_summary.csv

122driver_evidence_high_or_moderate_impact_log_count__source_count_1external_driver_evidence_tier_aggregatesCore Bio MAF v4 feature4 evidence tiers x 4 mutation summaries = 16 features. Evidence count is based on OncoKB annotated, COSMIC CGC v99 flag in OncoKB, IntOGen 2024 driver, and Vogelstein 2013.log1p count of high/moderate-impact mutations in genes with this evidence tierAdds graded external support for driver genes without exposing hundreds of exact genes unless the exact-gene block is selected in nested CV.The tumor has more protein-affecting mutations in cancer genes supported by this many external evidence channels.OncoKB Cancer Gene List, COSMIC CGC flag in OncoKB list, IntOGen 2024 driver compendium, Vogelstein et al. 2013 cancer-gene list.oncokb_cancer_genes.tsv and IntOGen Compendium_Cancer_Genes.tsv; direct COSMIC CGC download requires COSMIC login, so CGC is represented only by the OncoKB-provided CGC flag.Evidence tiers combine resources that are not fully independent and can favor well-studied genes.The tier is an aggregate, not a hand-picked pathway. It is predeclared, versioned, and lets the model learn whether stronger external support helps.No mutational signature exposures are included.Yes943948results\tables\proposed_clinical_bio_v4_feature_summary.csv
